scientific_integrity: The infinite theorem rests on an explicit proof using a tree cut bijection and fiberwise injection. A standalone finite checker supplies corroboration only; novelty was assessed with explicit residual risk and no independent certification.
scientific_limitations: The exact polynomial identity for the central rough-set fiber, shifted injection inequalities for all other fibers, and min-entropy formula hold for finite connected trees of order at least two with reflexive graph-neighborhood approximation operators. For cyclic graphs arbitrary edge subsets are not necessarily cuts; do not extend the identity without additional proof. Previous results on edge-cover polynomials and on the path special case are not new. Arithmetic-operation complexity is not bit complexity.
title: Unique worst-case rough-set ambiguity on every tree, with an edge-cover polynomial certificate
